Name: Overtons 11 Stand-Up Paddleboard
Natural: Well-suited to all-around recreational use or for sharing with friends, Overtons SUP is built with a lightweight EPS foam core and reinforced with dual 5mm wood stringers. Hand-laminated with 12-oz. fiberglass, epoxy, and IXPE slick skin bottom for excellent glide. Diamond-cut polyethylene deck pad provides a comfortable grip when standing, while the integrated EVA nose, tail, and rail bumpers protect against dings. Paddleboard includes accessory deck inserts, fin, and molded transport handle. Overtons 11 SUP weighs 32 lbs. For riders up to 230 lbs. 11L x 32"W.

Name: NRS Quick-Release SUP Leash Black
Natural: Stay connected to your board when necessary-and quickly disengage from your leash and board during a bad swim-with the help of the NRS Quick-Release SUP leash.
